estatePlan.concept: A cliff-garden Saint Lucian estate arranged as a contemporary Caribbean villa and an independent guest pavilion, with a westward leisure terrace and infinity pool framed by native lawn clearings. Arrival is deliberately calm and protected on the east, while the principal living rooms open toward sunset, sea and Piton-facing views to the west and southwest.
estatePlan.character: An exceptional approximately $15 million tropical-modern residence: warm pale stucco volumes, deep shade, local volcanic-stone landscape elements, dark metal detailing, expansive framed glazing and low, precise rooflines. The plan separates entertaining, private family life and back-of-house functions while retaining a relaxed indoor-outdoor resort character appropriate to Saint Lucia's humid marine climate.

requirements.statement: Design an extraordinary luxury estate aligned with a $15 million Saint Lucia commission.
Use a tropical-modern composition with broad shade, resilient mineral surfaces and view-oriented outdoor living appropriate to Saint Lucia.

program.role: Principal luxury residence with entertaining, owner accommodation and household operations.
Independent one-bedroom guest accommodation with its own entrance and garden approach.
West-facing outdoor leisure terrace and infinity pool.
Open tropical lawn clearings preserve breathing room around arrival and guest accommodation.

zones.purpose: Protected eastern vehicular arrival and formal approach to the main villa.
Open western and southern outdoor living zone focused on sunset views.
Quiet northern garden setting for independent guest accommodation.

architecture.intent: A long, low two-storey villa uses disciplined horizontal proportions to direct attention toward the western landscape and horizon.
A compact, independent garden pavilion remains visually subordinate to the main residence.

relationships.intent: The arrival gallery contains the private stair linking public entertaining spaces to the upper suite level.
The sunset terrace extends the main villa's south-facing lounges into the outdoor living zone.
The pool is aligned with the western open edge of the terrace to preserve a continuous view axis.
The landscaped walk gives the guest pavilion independent yet convenient access to the principal outdoor living area.

considerations.intent: The broad west glazing, pool and terrace are reserved for horizon and sunset views; the east is intentionally more controlled for arrival privacy.
Owner and guest sleeping suites occupy the upper floor above active entertaining and service rooms.
Lawn clearings keep the built volumes visually separated and retain generous tropical open space.
